en.title: Group and Sort Email Logs
en.description:
Given an email event log, group the events by sender. Sender groups are sorted lexicographically; within each group, events are sorted by timestamp in ascending order, then by recipient and subject in ascending lexicographic order. A subject may contain spaces and may also be empty.

The input format, examples, and test data were compiled and written by CSWork.
en.input: The first line contains n (1..200000), followed by n lines: a non-negative integer timestamp, sender, recipient, and subject. The sender and recipient contain no whitespace; the subject is the raw text from the 4th field of the line to the end of the line. Each line has at most 300 characters.
en.output: First output the number of result lines; then, following the rules, output `sender: <sender>`, followed by that group's `<timestamp> <recipient> [subject]` lines. When the subject is empty, do not output an extra space.
en.explanation: Process the input according to the rules above; see the accompanying solution for the approach, correctness proof, and complexity.
hints: Collect records by sender, sort them with the triple key `(timestamp, recipient, subject)`, and finally output them ordered by the sender key.
